Gap Description: No formal, recurring AI risk-management process is operating yet. The risk register exists but is not yet a governed, repeatable lifecycle activity with defined roles and cadence.
Recommended Action: Formalise the risk-management process: name the AI governance owner, set a recurring review cadence aligned to the 6-month retraining cycle plus ad hoc triggers, and document how new risks are identified, scored and escalated.
Residual Risk: Brings the umbrella risk-management control to Implemented. Underlying risk levels still depend on the specific fixes in G-02 through G-08.

Gap Description: CONFIRMED by the build: the subgroup analysis ran and found the model understates absolute risk for a disadvantaged subgroup by roughly nine times the gap seen elsewhere, despite balanced ranking and recall. Input data-quality checks still not built.
Recommended Action: Apply subgroup-aware calibration (e.g. separate Platt scaling per subgroup, or add the disadvantage signal to a compliant proxy feature reviewed for fairness) so absolute risk scores are not systematically low for this group, then add input data-quality validation before scoring, per system description s9.
Residual Risk: AR-01 to Medium (6), AR-02 to Low (4), matching the risk register's residual targets. Priority raised from 30-90 to 0-30 days now that the finding is confirmed, not projected.

Gap Description: The system description document now covers all Annex IV content, including the build-dependent sections (metrics, limitations, library versions), but it has not been formally reviewed and approved.
Recommended Action: Have the AI governance owner formally review and sign off the completed document.
Residual Risk: Closes a documentation gap and reduces the risk of a conformity assessment being delayed for missing paperwork.

Gap Description: Per-decision logging and post-market performance monitoring are designed but not built, there is no live system to log or monitor yet.
Recommended Action: Implement CloudTrail plus the per-decision record on the AWS build, and wire up drift monitoring with the defined retraining triggers (AUROC and subgroup-disparity thresholds).
Residual Risk: AR-05 to Medium (6). Closes the evidentiary gap behind AR-06's security monitoring.

Gap Description: The patient-notice approach and deployer-instructions content are decided but not yet drafted into a real notice or deployer agreement.
Recommended Action: Draft and publish the layered patient privacy notice at partner clinics, and finalise the deployer instructions and agreement covering AIA-12 responsibilities.

Gap Description: The human-oversight design (labelling, feature display, one-click dismiss and reorder) is specified but has never been tested with real clinician users under realistic workload.
Recommended Action: Run a usability validation with clinician users, refine the workflow based on findings, and formalise the quarterly outreach-outcome review.
Residual Risk: AR-03 to Medium (9), AR-08 to Medium (6).

Gap Description: CONFIRMED by the build: accuracy metrics were captured (AUROC 0.75, AUPRC 0.55) and reveal the model overfits (train AUC ~1.0) and is poorly calibrated. Adversarial robustness and endpoint security testing have not been run. Explainability display not built.
Recommended Action: Add regularisation and a calibration step (e.g. Platt scaling or isotonic regression), retrain with a time-based split, run adversarial robustness testing and a security review of the inference endpoint, and validate the top-features explanation with clinician testers.
Residual Risk: AR-04 to Medium (6), AR-10 to Medium/Low once regularised and calibrated (residual target not yet formally set in the risk register, follow up at the next register review).

Gap Description: No formal quality management system operates yet, there is no document control, change-management, or third-party component inventory process.
Recommended Action: Stand up a lightweight QMS: document control for the artefacts in this repository, a change-management process for model and data changes (per system description s10), and a component and licence inventory.

Gap Description: Whether MRRS is a medical device under the MDR is unresolved, so the correct conformity-assessment route cannot yet be finalised.
Recommended Action: Obtain a formal MDR qualification opinion from regulatory counsel, then execute the applicable conformity-assessment procedure once the route is confirmed.
Residual Risk: Resolves the largest open interpretive question in the classification. The outcome determines whether a notified body is required.

Gap Description: Registration in the EU database and the declaration of conformity cannot be completed until conformity assessment (G-09) is finished.
Recommended Action: Once G-09 concludes, register the system in the EU database and draw up the declaration of conformity and CE marking.

Gap Description: The ISO/IEC 42001 overlay gap check has not been run. This is deliberate, it is sequenced after the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF controls.
Recommended Action: Once G-01 through G-08 are substantially implemented, run the ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A gap check to identify any remaining AI management system gaps.
Residual Risk: Provides an independent cross-check that the primary frameworks' controls add up to a coherent AI management system.
